title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Configure text search language for multilingual environments (Text Search Language Optimizer)
summary: Text search language optimization in Business Central allows you to configure the search index for multilingual environments by selecting a primary data language. This improves search relevance and AI agent accuracy, though it requires reindexing all searchable data which should be done outside business hours.
key_points: Text search language optimization improves search result relevance when data is primarily in one language
The setting applies environment-wide and affects all users and AI agents like Sales Order Agent
Changing the language triggers a complete reindex of searchable data, which can take significant time depending on database size
New and updated data uses the new language setting immediately, but existing data reindexing happens as a background process

quotes.text: This optimization improves the relevance of search results for users who search in that language.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core benefit of configuring text search language for better search results in multilingual environments

quotes.text: We recommend that you make this change outside of business hours to minimize the impact on users.
quotes.why_it_matters: Critical operational guidance for implementing this feature without disrupting user access
